scripts.synth: npm run build && AWS_REGION=${AWS_REGION:-eu-north-1} cdk synth
scripts.synth:site: npm run build && if [ ! -f .env ]; then echo 'Missing infrastructure/.env; copy .env.dev to .env and fill in the values.' >&2; exit 1; fi && dotenv -e .env -- cdk synth CarbonVisualiserStack
scripts.synth:processing: npm run build && if [ ! -f .env ]; then echo 'Missing infrastructure/.env; copy .env.dev to .env and fill in the values.' >&2; exit 1; fi && dotenv -e .env -v CDK_PROCESSING_STACK=true -- cdk synth CarbonProcessingStack
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && if [ ! -f .env ]; then echo 'Missing infrastructure/.env; copy .env.dev to .env and fill in the values.' >&2; exit 1; fi && dotenv -e .env -- cdk deploy CarbonVisualiserStack
scripts.deploy:processing: npm run build && if [ ! -f .env ]; then echo 'Missing infrastructure/.env; copy .env.dev to .env and fill in the values.' >&2; exit 1; fi && dotenv -e .env -v CDK_PROCESSING_STACK=true -- cdk deploy CarbonProcessingStack
